caption:
One of these tumblers cost four times the other. Real cut crystal has sharp, precise facets and throws small rainbows in direct light. Pressed glass has rounder edges and a faint seam line running down one side where the mould closed. Run a finger along the rim before you buy. Crystal feels crisp under the finger. Glass feels soft. Comment your guess, A or B, before you scroll back up.
